dedupe_keys.name: multi resolution electricity consumption in 296 chinese cities

description: The urban-electricity research team publishes multi-resolution electricity-consumption estimates for 296 Chinese cities. The Figshare version 7 deposit provides an openly listed archive under CC BY 4.0. Its description frames the data as support for demand balancing and urban energy analysis where directly measured high-resolution series are scarce. The estimates can inform city-level load allocation and demand scenarios in power-system simulations using models such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that inferred local consumption is not a utility meter census. The mapping method, spatial resolution and time aggregation must be checked before treating the product as a calibration target. The article names supporting generation and validation code in a separate GitHub repository. The own data page and package manifest were inspected without downloading the archive or verifying every city and interval in the files.
